label: The command doc carries no format guidance at all: it is a pure router that hands workflow behaviour to the YAML and visible wording to the presentation contract, so no format rule can be fixed there and Q5 must edit the YAML step bodies instead

The command surface duplicates the two-tier threshold instead of deferring: the COMPACT/EXPANDED cut is defined in the template comment, restated in a FORMAT SELECTION comment and encoded as executable step logic in the autonomous workflow, duplicated twice in the interactive workflow, and only the rule detail is deferred to template Section 5

No setup field or prompt asks for a change count, so change_count is derived inside step 4 and Expanded becomes a machine-selected outcome: the autonomous workflow has approvals disabled and the interactive checkpoint offers Approve, Review, Modify and Regenerate but no option to choose the shorter format

No length, body-size or item-count gate exists anywhere on the command surface: every quantitative cap is per-unit (summary sentences, H4 heading words, H4 item paragraphs) and nothing caps the number of H2 sections or H4 items, with section count only reported and quality standards setting a floor without a ceiling

The completion display scores the quantities the long format maximises, reporting section count and files tracked while the body rules forbid file inventories in prose, so the run is scored on volume it tells the writer to hide

The release step imposes no body constraint and therefore publishes whatever the workflow produced: it strips the frontmatter block and the editorial H1, preserves spacing and hands the untruncated body to gh release create, so its only body rules are presentational

Upgrade-note guidance is action-typed but never section-ordered and the two files disagree in depth: the autonomous path gives Adopt/Repoint/Drop lead-ins, a no-migration fallback and the Upgrade versus Upgrade Notes split while the interactive path keeps one clause, and the phrase in section order appears only for glance bullets in the extend branch

Keep and drop wording points short at selection time but never at output size, and the rule the concise entry needs is absent: the drop list is per-item and nothing permits folding a group of small fixes into a single bullet list

Exemplar and scale clauses push long and the command surface inherits the template default instead of counterbalancing it: style_reference names the 535-line exemplar, the section-naming comment authorises scaling to a release the size of the exemplar, and per-item body budgets are generous with no aggregate cap

The two workflow files have drifted and the unattended path is the stricter one: the autonomous workflow carries a five-constraint WRITING STYLE block including plain English for a non-developer and keep only what the reader would act on, which the interactive workflow does not contain

Format compliance is a hard gate whose verification is satisfied most easily by the long format, because the gate requires only that all required sections be present and the expanded format supplies more of them by construction
